items.title: Electricity Coordination Group discusses extreme weather impacts on electricity security of supply in Central Europe and South-East Europe
items.description: The discussion took place against the backdrop of persistent high temperatures and record low water levels, all of which are putting pressure on electricity generation and demand in these regions.

items.title: Eurostat: EU economy greenhouse gas emissions: +0.3% in Q1 2026
